name: Kirka.io
description: A browser FPS with online servers, weapon unlocks, quests, and fast matches.
launchNotes: Direct launch is preferred for its JavaScript-heavy real-time client. The official site rendered a JavaScript prompt in source inspection, and its official client page describes performance options. No Aether game session or iframe compatibility was tested; use a top-level new tab if the embedded view hangs.

name: Lurkers.io
description: Explore a destructible 2D sandbox with zombie survival, Bedwars, team deathmatch, and community modes.
launchNotes: The developer describes an in-browser multiplayer game with several official modes. It is still in development and includes community-created modes and servers; review its public multiplayer and user-created content for the intended audience. Direct launch is preferred for networked play. No Aether game session or iframe compatibility was tested.

name: Wings.io
description: Fly a small plane in a multiplayer aerial shooter with shared rooms, pickups, and rotating event modes.
launchNotes: The official page describes mouse-controlled flight and shooting, room links, and multiplayer events. The source inspection showed a connection failure state, so availability and live matchmaking need a real browser check. Direct launch is preferred; no Aether game session or iframe compatibility was tested.

name: Starblast.io
description: Pilot an upgradeable ship through team, survival, invasion, and deathmatch modes.
launchNotes: The official page lists Team, Survival, Invasion, and Pro Deathmatch modes and warns that ad blockers may cause connection problems. Source inspection showed a connection-lost message, so treat this as a higher-risk compatibility candidate. Direct launch is preferred; gameplay and Aether embedding were not tested.

name: Kart Bros
description: Race colorful tracks solo or online, drift through corners, and use power-ups in multiplayer races.
launchNotes: The official page describes solo and real-time online races, keyboard controls, and a September 2026 update. It recommends Chrome and notes that blockers can interfere with loading. Direct launch is preferred; gameplay and Aether embedding were not tested.

name: HaxBall
description: A physics-driven football game where small teams score by striking a ball around an arena.
launchNotes: The developer documents real-time 3v3 and 4v4 play using WebRTC peer connections, and notes incomplete support in some browsers including Edge and Safari. Use a direct top-level browser tab first because proxy rewriting or embedded-browser policy may interfere with peer connectivity. No Aether game session was tested.

name: TagPro
description: Race as a rolling ball through team capture-the-flag matches, with public casual games and ranked play.
launchNotes: The official page currently shows public casual and ranked queues, keyboard controls, all-chat and team-chat features, and recent 2026 updates. Public chat and matchmaking are part of the game. Direct launch is preferred; no Aether game session or iframe compatibility was tested.

name: TETR.IO
description: A fast block-stacking game with solo challenges, ranked 1v1 duels, public rooms, and private matches.
launchNotes: The official site documents solo, ranked, public-room, and private-room play. It is a more competitive multiplayer option than the existing single-player Tetris entry. Direct launch is preferred for online play; the official page did not load through source inspection and Aether compatibility remains untested.

name: Soccer Bros
description: Quick arcade soccer matches with online play and invite-a-friend games.
launchNotes: The official page describes online multiplayer and says players can play against the computer or someone they invite. It recommends Chrome and warns that blocked sites or ad blockers can prevent loading. Direct launch is preferred; gameplay and Aether embedding were not tested.

name: Baseball Bros
description: Fast arcade baseball with batting, pitching, and baserunning in online multiplayer games.
launchNotes: The official page describes online multiplayer, multiple teams, and keyboard controls for batting, pitching, and stealing. It recommends Chrome and warns that blockers may interfere with loading. Direct launch is preferred; gameplay and Aether embedding were not tested.

name: Slow Roads
description: Take a solo drive through endless procedural roads, choosing the scenery and weather for a relaxed ride.
launchNotes: The developer describes a 3D procedural driving game with no ads or goals, and says the web version remains available. This is a solo-driving option rather than a racing or multiplayer game. Its 3D rendering may be demanding on low-end devices; that is an expectation, not a measured result. No Aether game session was tested.

name: Basket Bros
description: One-on-one arcade basketball with dunks, jump shots, and a large cast of characters.
launchNotes: The official page describes a fast 1v1 basketball game and notes that its arcade action includes cartoon punches. It recommends Chrome and warns that blockers can interfere with loading. Direct launch is preferred; gameplay and Aether embedding were not tested.

name: Hockey Bros
description: Quick arcade hockey matches with shooting, passing, checks, and online friend games.
launchNotes: The official page describes online matches and physical hockey checks, including stylized fighting. It recommends Chrome and says ad blockers or browser extensions can interfere. Review its cartoon contact content for the intended audience. Direct launch is preferred; gameplay and Aether embedding were not tested.

name: Wrestle Bros
description: A cartoon pro-wrestling brawler with CPU matches and online friend fights.
launchNotes: The official page describes pro-wrestling attacks, play against the CPU, and online matches with friends. It recommends Chrome and warns that blockers may prevent loading. Review its stylized combat for the intended audience. Direct launch is preferred; gameplay and Aether embedding were not tested.
